purpose: Which workflow FILES are 🔴 GATE per repo profile. The applier turns these into required_status_checks contexts by reading the check-run names the latest default-branch run of each file actually emitted (integration_id 15368). Contexts are never typed by hand.

context_derivation.source: GET /repos/{o}/{r}/contents/.github/workflows/{file} (verify uncommented pull_request/pull_request_target trigger for <default>; standards#1040) then GET /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/workflows/{file}/runs?branch=<default>&per_page=1 then GET /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/runs/{id}/jobs
context_derivation.context_shape: job name; for a reusable caller it is '<caller job id> / <reusable job name>'
context_derivation.if_no_pr_trigger: omit that file's contexts and report no_pr_trigger=[<file>]; never derive required_status_checks from a push/schedule/workflow_dispatch-only workflow on <default> that cannot fire on pull requests (standards#1040)
context_derivation.if_no_run_yet: omit that file's contexts and report it; never write a context nothing has emitted
context_derivation.if_zero_contexts_overall: do not write the required_status_checks rule at all; report the repo as UNGATED
context_derivation.never_required_match: an entry in never_required_contexts matches either the whole context or the part after the first " / " (the reusable job name); it is removed from the derived set, never typed
context_derivation.context_freeze: reusable job `name:` values and caller job ids are FROZEN until this derivation replaces every typed ruleset: renaming either turns a live required context into a phantom on every consumer. Adding a job is allowed. Guard: standards tests/test_governance_reusable_shape.sh

host.applies_to: repos that ship a desktop/GUI host workflow
